items.title: Shot A composition matches the reference
items.description: Long stairway climbs to the upper-right toward a fenced ledge; flagstone plaza fills the lower third; a lantern-hung branch reaches over the path on the left; trees + mist + light shafts fill the upper-left.
items.visualCriterion: Side by side with reference/frames/A_stairs.jpg the stairs, ledge, branch and plaza occupy the same screen regions and the eye reads the same composition.

items.title: Hero stairway: 18 worn stone steps
items.description: 16–20 irregular stone steps ~2.7 m wide, each tread a distinct slab with chipped/worn edges, dark risers, moss and grass in the joints, grassy embankments on both flanks, no repeated identical slabs.
items.visualCriterion: Steps read as individually cut, weathered stone with soft mossy edges like the reference, not extruded boxes.

items.title: Flagstone paths are real stones
items.description: Paths are built from ≥ 300 individually shaped flat stones (varying size 0.4–1.6 m, bevelled edges, height jitter ≤ 4 cm) with soil/moss/grass joints — not a tiled texture on a plane.
items.visualCriterion: At viewpoint E the stones have visible thickness, edge bevels and joints with greenery, matching the plaza in the reference.

items.title: Terraces and plateaus at authored heights
items.description: East plateau (top of stairs) ≈ 5.4 m, west ledge ≈ 2.6 m, house terrace ≈ 1.2 m, plaza ≈ 0 m; all within 0.35 m.

items.title: Terrain is authored at four scales
items.description: Macro forms (plateaus, valleys), medium (embankments, ledges, erosion channels), small (depressions, stones, roots) and micro (soil roughness) are all present; the detail zone has ≥ 250k terrain vertices; no visible grid or displaced-plane look.
items.visualCriterion: Embankments beside the stairs and the ledge edges show natural terracing and erosion, not smooth noise blobs.

items.title: Layered ground materials
items.description: Terrain material blends ≥ 4 physically based layers (soil, grass, moss, leaf litter, path stone) by slope/mask/noise with detail normal maps and macro colour variation; no obvious tiling at 1280 px.
items.visualCriterion: Ground at viewpoint E shows soil/moss/grass transitions with fine roughness like the reference plaza edges.

items.title: Ground litter is geometry
items.description: ≥ 5,000 instanced litter pieces (fallen leaves, twigs, pebbles, small roots) within the detail radius, seated on the terrain.

items.title: White-bark trees: ≥ 8 real variants
items.description: Verdant Forest white-bark trees ported and improved: ≥ 8 geometry variants with different taper, lean, branching hierarchy and crown shape; bark shows white/grey variation with dark scars.
items.visualCriterion: Trunks are irregular, tapered, leaning, with hierarchical branches — recognisably the Verdant white trees, better.

items.title: Giant Kokiri trees with roots and limbs
items.description: ≥ 6 giant trees (trunk radius ≥ 1.2 m) with flared buttress roots entering the terrain, gnarled bark, at least 2 large near-horizontal limbs each.
items.visualCriterion: Giant trunks read like the massive old trees framing the house in the reference.

items.title: Canopy roofs the clearing
items.description: From viewpoint F the canopy covers most of the sky: sky pixels ≤ 45 % of the frame; dappled shafts pass through gaps.
items.visualCriterion: Overhead reads as a dense, layered canopy with light breaking through like the top of the reference frames.

items.title: Foliage is 3D leaf clusters
items.description: Leaves are individually placed curved laminae (or multi-leaf cards with normal-mapped depth), grouped in asymmetric clusters — no smooth spheres/blobs; leaves flutter with wind.
items.visualCriterion: Crown edges are broken and leafy against the sky; no ball-shaped canopies.

items.title: Tree bases contact the ground
items.description: Every tree base vertex sits within 3 cm of the terrain (no floating trunks, no buried crowns).

items.title: Distant tree layers
items.description: ≥ 400 mid/far trees with ≥ 2 LOD levels form layered silhouettes in the haze beyond the detail radius.

items.title: Lantern branch over the path
items.description: A large near-horizontal limb from the west-ledge giant crosses above the path on the left of shot A, carrying 3 glowing pod lanterns on cords, with leaf clusters.
items.visualCriterion: Matches the branch + lanterns at the left of the reference stairs shot.

items.title: Grass density
items.description: ≥ 400,000 GPU-instanced grass blades/clumps within the detail radius, ≥ 3 grass types (short, tall, weeds), zero on flagstones and stairs.
items.visualCriterion: Embankments and verges are thick with grass like the reference; bare ground is rare except on paths.

items.title: Grass variation
items.description: Per-instance variation in height (CV ≥ 0.2), width, yaw, colour (≥ 3 tints) and clustering (density noise), not a uniform carpet.

items.title: Ferns
items.description: ≥ 300 ferns with pinnate frond geometry on embankments and around tree bases.

items.title: Purple flowers and weeds
items.description: ≥ 150 purple flower clusters (as in the left foreground of shots A and D) plus yellow-green weeds; purple pixels ≥ 0.3 % of shot D.
items.visualCriterion: Purple blooms sit in the left foreground of shot D similar to the reference.

items.title: Bushes and shrubs
items.description: ≥ 80 bushes with 3D leaf geometry along embankments, ledges and house bases.

items.title: Moss everywhere it should be
items.description: Moss on boulders, stair edges, roots, the house roof and the log arch, as surface-bound geometry or blended material.
items.visualCriterion: Mossy greens soften every hard edge as in the reference house roof and boulders.

items.title: Sprouts in stone joints
items.description: ≥ 500 grass/weed sprouts growing from flagstone and stair joints.

items.title: Layered wind
items.description: ≥ 4 distinct wind responses (grass fast, small plants light, leaves flutter, branches slow); motion between t and t+0.5 s is present but spatially varied (motion variance across 16 regions > 0).
items.visualCriterion: Grass ripples independently of the canopy sway; no lock-step motion.

items.title: Hero mossy boulders
items.description: ≥ 3 hero boulders at the layout positions with fractured, faceted silhouettes (ridged displacement, cracks), moss on top faces, seated with contact darkening.
items.visualCriterion: Boulder at the left of shot D reads as layered, mossy rock like the reference, not a smooth blob.

items.title: Scree and pebbles
items.description: ≥ 2,000 instanced small stones/pebbles near path edges, stair feet and boulder bases.

items.title: Kokiri tree-trunk houses
items.description: ≥ 2 houses: hollow trunk walls with bark ridges, dark arched doorway with warm interior light, mossy thatched dome roof grown over by living branches and heart-leaf vines.
items.visualCriterion: The house on the right of shot B matches the reference: proportions, dome roof, glowing doorway.

items.title: Glowing pod lanterns
items.description: ≥ 6 yellow-orange pod lanterns (Deku-nut shaped, emissive + point light, hanging on cords) across the houses, branch and log arch; glow restrained (no blown-out bloom).
items.visualCriterion: Lanterns read as warm glowing pods like the reference, with soft local light on the bark.

items.title: Wooden signpost
items.description: A wooden signpost (post + carved plank with rune-like marks) in front of the house terrace.

items.title: Fences on the upper ledge
items.description: ≥ 2 post-and-rail wooden fence runs along the plateau edge at the top of the stairs.

items.title: Giant hollow log arch
items.description: A huge fallen hollow log (radius ≈ 3.4 m) lying across the northern path in the mist with bark ridges, moss, and 2 lanterns — the far landmark of shot D.
items.visualCriterion: Shot D shows the log arch silhouette in haze like the reference.

items.title: Sun matches the reference
items.description: Sun from behind-left of shot A at ~30–40° elevation: shadows on the plaza fall toward camera-right/front; azimuth within ±25° and elevation within ±10° of the reference estimate.
items.visualCriterion: Shadow direction and softness on the plaza match the reference.

items.title: God rays through the canopy
items.description: Volumetric light shafts (screen-space or geometric) enter from the upper-left in shots A, B and F, occluded by the canopy.
items.visualCriterion: Shafts are visible, soft, and directional as in the reference; they do not wash the whole frame.

items.title: Layered atmospheric perspective
items.description: Cool blue-grey haze increases with depth; low ground mist in the north hollow; distant trees still silhouette through it; fog far ≥ 150 m and the horizon is not a flat fog wall.
items.visualCriterion: Shot D depth reads in 3+ planes (foreground stones, mid boulders/trees, far log in mist) like the reference.

items.title: Falling leaves, motes and the fairy
items.description: ≥ 60 falling leaf particles and ≥ 100 drifting motes/fireflies in the detail zone, plus a glowing fairy orb with wings hovering near the player spawn.

items.title: Palette matches the reference
items.description: For each hero viewpoint: mean hue within 14°, mean saturation within ±0.10 and mean luminance within ±0.12 of its reference frame (computed on 64×36 downscales, sky masked).

items.title: Rendering clarity
items.description: Image sharpness (Laplacian variance) of each hero capture ≥ 0.8× its reference frame; over-exposed pixels ≤ 1 %; no full-frame blur or bloom.

items.title: Contact: nothing floats
items.description: Ambient occlusion / contact darkening under rocks, roots, stairs and house bases; all sampled placements within 3 cm of the terrain.
items.visualCriterion: Every asset in viewpoint E looks physically seated with a soft contact shadow.

items.title: Shot similarity to the reference
items.description: Structural similarity (SSIM on 256×144 luminance) between each hero viewpoint and its reference frame ≥ 0.42, and pHash Hamming distance ≤ 26.

items.title: Real-time budget
items.description: ≤ 700 draw calls and ≤ 9 M triangles per hero viewpoint at quality=high; PROJECT_STATE documents ≥ 30 fps at 1080p on a mid-range GPU.

items.title: GPU instancing
items.description: Vegetation, litter, pebbles and distant trees use InstancedMesh (≥ 20 instanced meshes in the scene).

items.title: LOD and culling
items.description: Trees and grass have ≥ 2 LOD levels; vegetation is chunked with distance culling.

items.title: Deterministic captures
items.description: Two captures of the same build at the same viewpoint differ in < 0.5 % of pixels.

items.title: Dev camera, viewpoints, clean console
items.description: Free dev camera with ≥ 6 saved viewpoints; zero console errors or page errors during capture.

items.title: Young Link
items.description: Original child-proportioned model (~1.25 m): green tunic, long green cap, blond hair, pointed ears, brown boots, belt, white undershirt.
items.visualCriterion: Silhouette and colours match the reference Link without using any Nintendo asset.

items.title: Deku Shield and Kokiri Sword
items.description: Wooden Deku Shield with red swirl on the back; Kokiri Sword in a scabbard; both original models.
items.visualCriterion: Matches the equipment screen renders in the reference.

items.title: Locomotion
items.description: Idle, walk, run and stair-climb animations with foot planting on the heightfield; third-person follow camera at reference height.

items.title: Navi companion
items.description: Glowing fairy with wings orbiting the player with a sparkle trail.

items.title: Kokiri kids
items.description: ≥ 2 Kokiri NPCs in dark-green outfits at the layout NPC spots with idle animation.

items.title: HUD
items.description: Three red hearts top-left, item slot top-right (Deku Stick ×4 with ZR label), hand-drawn Kokiri Forest minimap bottom-right.
items.visualCriterion: Positions, sizes and style match the reference HUD.

items.title: Pause / equipment screen
items.description: Tabs Collection / Equipment / Items / System, rupee counter 16/200, hexagonal slot grid, character in an oval vignette, item name + description, Rotate/Set/Back button hints.
items.visualCriterion: Layout and styling match the reference inventory frame.

items.title: UI art style
items.description: Dark wood/parchment frame with ornate corner scrollwork, warm gold accents, crisp text at 1080p.
items.visualCriterion: Reads as the same visual family as the reference menus.
